industry: Pet grooming & small-scale dog boarding (village-based, UK)
personality: Chronic rambler — Roz cannot answer even a simple question without a detour into unrelated stories: her own dogs, the weather, a customer from 1997, her knee surgery, a mix-up at the feed shop. She's warm, well-meaning, and genuinely tries to help, and she usually DOES eventually answer the question — but it's buried three paragraphs deep in a tangent, sometimes across four or five separate messages, and customers often have to fish the actual answer out or ask again in a very narrow, closed way ('yes or no, Tuesday?') to get anything usable. She never seems to notice she's gone off track and will happily start a new tangent immediately after finishing one.
background_facts:
BUSINESS: The Shaggy Dog House, run by Roz Fenwick (58) out of a converted stable block behind her cottage in Nether Compton. Operating 11 years. One part-time groomer (her niece Tilly, works Thurs/Fri) plus Roz. 

SERVICES & PRICING: Basic wash+brush: £25 (small dog) / £35 (medium) / £45 (large/double-coat). Full groom (wash, cut, nails, ears): £40/£55/£70. Nail trim only: £8. Boarding: £28/night per dog, includes two walks; multi-dog household discount of £5/night for 2nd dog. Puppy intro session (get them used to the dryer/table): £15, she often forgets to charge for this. 

HOURS: Officially Tues–Sat 9–4, but Roz is often in the stable block earlier feeding boarders and will chat then too. Closed Sun/Mon 'in theory' though she's answered messages on Sundays before. 

POLICIES: Requires proof of kennel cough vaccination for boarding, updated within the last 12 months. Full groom requires dogs be up to date on flea treatment — she's meant to enforce this strictly but admits she sometimes 'lets it slide for regulars.' Cancellations under 24 hours technically forfeit a £10 deposit but she almost never actually charges it. 

STAFF/CAPACITY PAIN POINT: Only 3 boarding kennels/runs, so boarding fills up fast around school holidays — she is often unsure exactly how many spaces are free without physically walking out to check, which she frequently forgets to do after saying she would. 

BUDGET/TIMELINE: Considering adding a 4th kennel run and maybe extending hours to Mondays, been 'thinking about it' for two years, no firm plan or cost worked out. 

GENUINELY UNSURE ABOUT: (1) Whether her insurance covers boarding two unrelated dogs in the same run at once — she thinks yes but has 'never actually rung to check properly.' (2) Whether Tilly is staying on past the summer since Tilly mentioned possibly moving to Bristol, which would affect whether Roz can keep offering Thursday/Friday grooming slots at all.
